questions.sentence: Pocket Haven is best described as…
options: A portable home base the party carries between worlds.
An underground city run by goblins.
A small kingdom in the eastern peaks.
questions.explanation: Pocket Haven is the party's portable base — farms, kitchens, and workbenches travel between worlds with them.

questions.sentence: What gives the Frostwood its name?
options: Ice never thaws on the leaves of its silver pines.
Bandits once froze a king inside its largest tree.
It's the home of a god of cold.
questions.explanation: Frostwood's silver pines carry a permanent ice glaze — a leftover from an ancient frost spirit.

questions.sentence: Before joining the guild, Bin was known for…
questions.explanation: Bin's signature jester reputation predates the campaign.

questions.sentence: Jester Points (JP) are typically earned by…
options: Entertaining people — performances, jokes, surprising choices.
questions.explanation: JP rewards style and entertainment, not pure power. Tavern trivia is a classic JP source.

questions.sentence: When a 'Frozen' wolf appears, you can expect…
options: Ice resistance and a chilling aura.
questions.explanation: Frozen is a procedural enemy modifier — adds ice resistance and a defensive aura.

questions.sentence: What is the danger of an 'Alpha' monster modifier?
options: It buffs nearby allies of the same family.
It heals when low on HP.
questions.explanation: Alpha modifiers turn pack leaders into force multipliers — kill them first.

questions.sentence: Chaining successful QTEs in combat builds…
options: A combo multiplier that boosts your next attack.
questions.explanation: Combo system: each successful QTE in a row grows a damage bonus for the next swing.

questions.sentence: The 'Memory Shards' you collect on adventures are used for…
questions.explanation: Memory Shards are the campaign's universal passive-rank-up currency.

questions.sentence: If you spare a bandit in conversation, the most likely later consequence is…
options: He turns up later to help, or to betray, depending on your other choices.
questions.explanation: Spared characters are tracked by the consequence system; they can return as allies or villains.

questions.sentence: Mummy Maze and Push Box puzzles in Pocket Haven are usually framed as…
options: Training drills set up by Bin to keep the party sharp between adventures.
questions.explanation: The minigames are framed as training and mental-sharpening drills — they grant contextual buffs on win.

questions.sentence: Perfectly timing the cooking minigame yields…
options: A bonus +1 to the dish's buffed stat plus full potency.
questions.explanation: A 'perfect' cook adds a +1 stat bonus on top of the full-potency buff.
